column1: # mapping_set_description: "LOINC part to Protein Ontology mappings. Parts carrying a '^' qualifier denote a measurement context (timing, specimen order, posture, challenge protocol) applied to the same underlying entity; these are asserted as skos:broadMatch, since the LOINC part is narrower than the ontology concept. Unqualified parts use skos:exactMatch. Rows carrying semapv:AgentBasedMatching are the unqualified COMPONENT parts, derived by matching the qualified part's base label to a LOINC COMPONENT part and inheriting the curated target; part type was verified against CompLOINC. Predicate revisions on qualified parts, and the derived unqualified rows, were produced by an LLM agent (semapv:AgentBasedMatching); the underlying subject-object mappings remain the original manual curation."
